items.name: Radiant Core
items.desc: The universal Awakening material. Hums faintly with potential and mild static.

items.name: Ember Core
items.desc: Awakening material for Fire heroes. Warm to the touch. Then hot. Then VERY hot.

items.name: Tide Core
items.desc: Awakening material for Water heroes. Sloshes even when perfectly still.

items.name: Bloom Core
items.desc: Awakening material for Nature heroes. Sprouted twice in storage. Confiscated a third time.

items.name: Dawn Core
items.desc: Awakening material for Light heroes. Glows brighter when someone nearby is about to succeed.

items.name: Dusk Core
items.desc: Awakening material for Dark heroes. Absorbs light and, apparently, compliments.

items.name: Skill Tome
items.desc: Teaches an old hero new tricks. Slightly overdue at the library.

items.name: Training Scroll
items.desc: Compressed experience. Reading it feels like a montage.

items.name: Spark Essence
items.desc: What duplicate heroes become past max Ascension. Trades for wonderful things.

items.name: Meadow Clover
items.desc: A four-leaf clover from the Very Normal Meadow. Filed under 'luck, minor'.

items.name: Ember Shard
items.desc: A flake of spicy slime residue. Do not taste. Greg tasted it. Greg is fine, but still.

items.name: Dew Drop
items.desc: Morning dew, harvested at great personal dampness.

items.name: Wolf Biscuit
items.desc: Union-approved training treat. The wolves negotiated for the good flavor.

items.name: Rogue Honey
items.desc: Non-union honey. Delicious and legally complicated.

items.name: Sad Spore
items.desc: A mushroom spore radiating gentle disappointment.

items.name: Speed Shell
items.desc: Proof that the snail was never slow. Grants nothing but respect.

items.name: Meeting Minutes
items.desc: Notes from a meeting that could have been an email. Somehow valuable.

items.name: Tie Fragment
items.desc: A scrap of managerial necktie. Faintly smells of quarterly ambition.

items.name: Union Card
items.desc: Honorary membership, Local 12 (Wolves, Bees, and Allied Fauna).

items.name: Gerald's Name Tag
items.desc: ASK ME ABOUT QUOTAS. You will not ask him about quotas.

items.name: Bark Form MT-7
items.desc: A permit application written on living bark. It rustles when denied.

items.name: Sap Ink
items.desc: Official Darkwood ink. Signatures made with it are legally binding and sticky.

items.name: Permit Stub
items.desc: Proof you were permitted, briefly, to exist here.

items.name: Coal Chunk
items.desc: Premium Mount Grumble coal. The bats sleep on it.

items.name: Strike Flyer
items.desc: FAIR WAGES OR NO FORGES. Suitable for framing.

items.name: Grumble Ore
items.desc: High-grade ore that complains quietly while smelting.

items.name: Brine Ticket
items.desc: Your place in the underwater queue. Position: 8. Position: still 8.

items.name: Pearl Button
items.desc: From the Hold Queen's cardigan. Wait — the Taxlord has the cardigan. It's complicated.

items.name: Kelp Cable
items.desc: Organic phone line. Carries calls and nutrients.

items.name: Facet File
items.desc: A personnel file refracted into seventeen versions of the truth.

items.name: Onboarding Geode
items.desc: Crack it open to reveal a welcome packet and two forms of ID.

items.name: Morale Shard
items.desc: Crystallized team spirit. Handle with enthusiasm.

items.name: Ecto-Form 1743
items.desc: An HOA violation notice that phases through walls to find you.

items.name: Lawn of the Month Trophy
items.desc: Posthumously awarded. The ghost still mows.

items.name: The Casserole Dish
items.desc: You must return it. You cannot return it. It must be returned.

items.name: Sugar Crystal
items.desc: Raw dessert-grade sugar from the dunes. Crunchy with destiny.

items.name: Frosting Vial
items.desc: Emergency buttercream. For morale, or structural repairs.

items.name: Sprinkle Pouch
items.desc: Tactical sprinkles. Deploy responsibly.

items.name: Cloud Shipping Label
items.desc: Address: SKY. Handle with care: contents may be weather.

items.name: Storm Tape
items.desc: Packing tape charged with static. Seals boxes and hair.

items.name: Lost Parcel
items.desc: Nine years in transit. Whatever is inside has unionized.

items.name: Spa Voucher
items.desc: One free session. The fine print is a haiku about never leaving.

items.name: Pumice Stone
items.desc: Volcanic exfoliant. The golem swears by it.

items.name: Cucumber Slice
items.desc: Rescued from the Horror. Still cold. Still crisp. Still watching.

items.name: Bone Ticket
items.desc: Necropolis DMV queue ticket, carved in femur. Number: 4,000,001.

items.name: Expired License
items.desc: The photo is terrible. The bearer is deceased. Renewal pending.

items.name: Soul Stamp
items.desc: APPROVED, in ectoplasm. Valid in this life and the next.

items.name: Enchanted Gift Card
items.desc: Balance: $4.17. It cannot be spent. It cannot be discarded. It is eternal.

items.name: Cursed Pretzel Salt
items.desc: Blessed by the food court, cursed by cardiologists.

items.name: Kiosk Key
items.desc: Opens any mall kiosk. The goblins would like it back.

items.name: Glacier Deed
items.desc: Certified ownership of one (1) glacier, slowly departing.

items.name: Frost Brochure
items.desc: IMAGINE... OWNING... WINTER. Glossy. Cold. Persuasive.

items.name: Icicle Pen
items.desc: For signing frozen contracts. Melts if you hesitate. HESITATE.

items.name: First-Class Seal
items.desc: The Royal Post's highest honor. Not the animal. Usually.

items.name: Wax Blob
items.desc: Sealing wax with opinions about your handwriting.

items.name: Undeliverable Letter
items.desc: Addressed to 'The Hero'. That's you. It got here anyway.

items.name: Agenda Scroll
items.desc: Item one: violence. Item two: follow-ups from violence.

items.name: Action Item
items.desc: Assigned to: someone. Due: eventually. Status: haunting you.

items.name: Whiteboard Shard
items.desc: A fragment reading 'DO NOT ERA—'. The rest is lost forever.

items.name: Moon Lease
items.desc: One lunar month, renewable. Landlord: deposed. Rent: rice cakes.

items.name: Rabbit Pamphlet
items.desc: KNOW YOUR TENANT RIGHTS, printed on rice paper. Edible. Educational.

items.name: Crater Chalk
items.desc: For outlining property disputes and hopscotch tribunals.

items.name: Infernal Ticket Stub
items.desc: Case #666,001. Status: Open. Status: Always open.

items.name: Brimstone Headset
items.desc: Warm on the ears. Whispers hold music when nobody's calling.

items.name: Escalation Sigil
items.desc: Skips one tier of support. Use wisely. There are nine.

items.name: Star Chalk
items.desc: Grip chalk ground from retired constellations. Legendary hold.

items.name: Cosmic Protein
items.desc: One scoop contains a nebula. Shake well. VERY well.

items.name: Astral Gym Card
items.desc: CANCELLED, at last. Framed by the Guild of Gains as a holy relic.

items.name: Form PRIME-1
items.desc: The form from which all forms descend. Handle with reverence and gloves.

items.name: Stapler of Doom
items.desc: Binds documents and fates. Red, naturally.

items.name: Carbon Copy
items.desc: A perfect copy of a document nobody has the original of.

items.name: Cell Fragment
items.desc: A shard of cell B7. Still holds the value 42. Nobody knows why.

items.name: Formula Rune
items.desc: =POWER(you,2). Ancient. Auditable.

items.name: Freeze Pane
items.desc: A pane of frozen perspective. Keeps your headers visible in any storm.

items.name: Executive Seal
items.desc: The CEO of Everything's own seal. Now stamps things FOR the people.

items.name: Universal KPI
items.desc: The one metric that matters. It reads: 'friendship, trending up'.

items.name: Golden Stapler
items.desc: Awarded for surviving the top floor of reality. Staples: infinite.

items.name: Bog Receipt
items.desc: Tax Season event token. Proof of payment, slightly damp.

items.name: Sprinkle Token
items.desc: Pastry Uprising event token. Legal tender in the Great Dessert.

items.name: Rice Cake Token
items.desc: Moon Rent Strike event token. Backed by the full faith of the rabbits.

items.name: Mall Token
items.desc: Midnight Madness event token. Expires never, unlike your patience.

items.name: Rep Token
items.desc: Astral Gym event token. One rep, tokenized. Non-transferable gains.

items.name: Derby Ticket
items.desc: Snail Derby event token. Redeem before the race ends (no rush).

items.name: Amnesty Stamp
items.desc: Permit Amnesty event token. Forgives one (1) bureaucratic sin.

items.name: Crown Fragment
items.desc: A shard from a sovereign of silliness. Collect them all. Rule nothing.

items.name: The Taxlord's Cardigan
items.desc: Sensible. Terrifying. Machine washable.
